ugh: Used to express repugnance, disgust, or annoyance.
uglier: comparative form of ugly: more ugly
ugliest: superlative form of ugly: most ugly
uglification: The process of being made ugly or uglified.
uglified: simple past and past participle of uglify
uglifier: One who or that which uglifies.
uglifies: third-person singular simple present indicative of uglify
uglify: To make ugly; to destroy or worsen the appearance or attractiveness of.
uglifying: present participle and gerund of uglify
ugly: Displeasing to the eye; aesthetically unpleasing.
ugsome: Ugly; horrible; disgusting; offensive, loathsome, repellent.
